name: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd
title: Mayur Uniquoters Ltd-$ - 522249 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mayur Uniquoters Q4 FY26 standalone PAT up 73% to INR 60.71 cr on export mix and FX gain, but margin sustainability is hedged and FX-aided; capacity add is a single coating line of ~5 lakh meters/month.

capex.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only.

triggers.label: Coating line ordered, capex ~INR 50 cr
triggers.quote: because we are doing it in an existing facility, it will be within INR 50 Cr.

triggers.label: Automotive price hikes lagging 1-2 months
triggers.quote: Yes. So, I told you we have taken some price hike for domestic customers in footwear open market.

triggers.label: FX gain ~INR 30 cr inflates other income
triggers.quote: our other income includes this foreign exchange gain of around INR 30 crores.

triggers.label: Export growth 15-20% reiterated, margin 25-26% guide
triggers.quote: we have given a very clear guidance of 25%-26% in the past. We should be able to maintain that for sure.

triggers.label: General export hit by war and tariffs
triggers.quote: because of the war situation, our general export market was temporarily impacted.

guidance.value: 8%-10% p.a. for FY27 and next 2-3 years
guidance.quote: between 8%-10%, the value will be approximately the same in this year and the next 2-3 years.
we should see somewhere around 15%-20%-25% growth in the export business.
we have given a very clear guidance of 25%-26% in the past. We should be able to maintain that for sure.

guidance.value: INR 300 cr for global plant; ~INR 50 cr this year for India coating line
guidance.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we registered a total growth of 15% in value and out of that, around 35.5%, we achieved the growth in export and 4% plus we achieved in domestic.
If we see on year basis our export growth is 35% and automotive is 50%.
we have given a very clear guidance of 25%-26% in the past.

red_flags.label: Q4 margin flattered by FX gain and price pass-through timing
red_flags.quote: this foreign exchange gain is also giving impact because of increase in dollar prices.

red_flags.label: Inconsistent export growth numbers under questioning
Management reluctant to give quarterly or numeric pipeline detail
red_flags.quote: I cannot comment on quarter-to-quarter basis right now.

evasions.quote: Trying to maintain it but it depends on the situation.
What is in the pipeline and we are not sure we don't want to comment on those things right now.
Sir, you told you to hold on to 15% to 20%.
